title: Hot Or Cold Game
code:
// === Tab: mySketch.js ===
/*
by Metamere, 4-20-2024
for the Weekly Creative Coding Challenge, topic: Feedback


Controls:
-Press [F] or touch to go to fullscreen (except on mobile iOS)
-Click anywhere on the screen to make the finder circle move to a new location
-press [Pause] or [Spacebar] or double-click to pause / unpause
-double-click or press [Enter] to proceed at end of level or game over screens

debugging / testing:
-Press [e] to end level
-number keys [1-8] to restart on the corresponding level.

version 2 update 5-13-2024
2.1 update, 5-16-2024, now requires at least 5 found per set to advance, a score is now calculated, and
limits drop off linearly from 11 on (after reaching the horizontal asymptote at level 10)
2.2 update, 5-18-2024, added ability to do a review of a level once completed.
*/

p5.disableFriendlyErrors = true

const set_number_init = 1 // default = 1, of course. But you can start higher for harder difficulty.
const speed_factor_init = 10 // default = 10
const limit_reduction_factor = 0.68 // makes it so the limits reach the minimum for set 10.
const colors = {
	time:[200,50,0], 
	moves: [50,150,50], 
	steps: [0,50,150],
	warning: [230,0,0],
}
const col_opacity_1 = 200
const col_opacity_2 = 125
const limit = {time_i:60, moves_i:30, steps_i:2500, time:0, moves:0, steps:0}
const total_levels = 8
var level_number_init = 1
 
var display_scale_factor, level, remaining, proceed
var results_displayed, replay_mode, command_index, totals
var hint_angle, init_frame, level_info, positive, negative, my_font
var graphics_layer, gui_layer, save_img_button, image_coords
var results_buffers = []
var commands
var infographic_buffer, level_end_buffer

function preload(){
	graphics_layer = createGraphics(1,1)
	// hidden_graphics_layer = createGraphics(1,1)
	gui_layer = createGraphics(1,1)
	infographic_buffer = createGraphics(1,1)
	level_end_buffer = createGraphics(1,1)
	for(let level_index = 0; level_index < total_levels; level_index++){
		const buffer = createGraphics(1,1)
		results_buffers.push(buffer)
	}
	my_font = loadFont('file:///Users/unclerm/Vibe Coding/4K MV Visual Integration Editor/assets_cache/ChivoMono_SemiBold.ttf')
	save_img_button = createButton('Save results')
	save_img_button.hide()
	game = {id:~~random(10000), set:set_number_init, score:0}
}

function setup(init=true) {
	fps = 60
	time_increment = 1/fps
	frameRate(fps)

	if(init){
		createCanvas(W = windowWidth, H = windowHeight)
		noStroke()
		gui_layer.fill(220, 170, 0)
		gui_layer.noStroke()
		graphics_layer.noStroke()
		textFont(my_font)
		gui_layer.textFont(my_font)
		graphics_layer.textFont(my_font)
		iOSiPadOS = (/^iP/.test(navigator.platform) || /^Mac/.test(navigator.platform) && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 4)
	}
	else{
		resizeCanvas(W = windowWidth, H = windowHeight)
	}

	// hidden_graphics_layer.resizeCanvas(W, H)
	level_end_buffer.resizeCanvas(W, H)
	graphics_layer.resizeCanvas(W, H)
	gui_layer.resizeCanvas(W, H)

	// W = windowWidth
	// H = windowHeight
	w = W/2
	h = H/2
	S = min(W, H)
	s = S/2

	y_margin = 0.06
	image_scale = 0.25
	
	ts = min(50, S * 0.055)
	top_text_margin = ts * 4
	ts2 = ts * 0.75
	ts4 = ts/4
	textSize(ts)

	image_coords_ratio = [0, ts2 * 5 / H, 1, y_margin + image_scale * 2]
	image_coords = [0 * image_coords_ratio[0], H * image_coords_ratio[1], 
									W * image_coords_ratio[2], H * image_coords_ratio[3]]
	// corner_coords = [{x:0, y:0}, {x:W, y:0}, {x:W, y:H}, {x:0, y:H}]
	corner_coords = [{x:-S, y:-S}, {x:W+S, y:-S}, {x:W+S, y:H+S}, {x:-S, y:H+S}]

	textAlign(CENTER)
	gui_layer.textSize(ts)
	graphics_layer.textSize(ts)
	graphics_layer.textAlign(CENTER)
	
	const button_w = S * 0.365
	const button_h = ts * 1.5
	save_img_button.size(button_w, button_h)
	save_img_button.position(W/2 - button_w/2, image_coords[1] + image_coords[3] + ts/2)
	save_img_button.mousePressed(save_results)
	save_img_button.style("font-size", ts + "px")
	save_img_button.id('SAVE_BUTTON')

	display_scale_factor = max(W, H) / 2560
	
	const manual_scale_factor = 0.65
	finder_diam = S * 0.05 * manual_scale_factor
	target_diam = finder_diam / 2

	speed_factor = speed_factor_init * display_scale_factor * manual_scale_factor
	
	hotter_threshold = finder_diam * 5
	colder_threshold = finder_diam * 7
	
	finder = {x:w, y:h, d:finder_diam, d2:0, sw:max(1,finder_diam/20)}
	finder.move_speed = speed_factor
	update_frequency_nominal = Math.ceil(finder.d / finder.move_speed)
	finder.distance_to_target = 0
	
	target = {x:0, y:0, d:target_diam}
	target.margin = target.d * (0.5 + 1 + 1 * (S < 1000))
	target.color = [220,170,0]

	paused = false

	level_number = level_number_init
	set_completed = false
	results_displayed = false
	level_results = []
	for(let i = 0; i < total_levels; i++){
		level_results.push({time: 1, moves: 1, steps: 10})
	}
	totals = {time:0, moves: 0, steps:0, score:0}
	const n = pow(limit_reduction_factor, game.set-1)
	initial = {}
	
	const endgame = max(0, game.set - 10)

	limit.time = ~~(limit.time_i/2) - 1 + Math.ceil((limit.time_i/2 + 1) * n - 1 * endgame)
	limit.moves = ~~(limit.moves_i/2) - 1 + Math.ceil((limit.moves_i/2 + 1) * n - 0.5 * endgame)
	limit.steps = ~~(limit.steps_i/2) - 50 + Math.ceil((limit.steps_i/2 + 50) / 50 * n - 0.5 * endgame) * 50
	initialize_level(level_number)
	start_time = ~~millis()
	frame_count_temp = 0
	frame_count = 0
	mouse = {x:0, y:0}
	found_targets = 0
	save_img_button.hide()
}

var marked = false
function pause_screen(pause_game, display_instructions=false){
	if(pause_game){
		update_counters()
		if(level.moves && paused){
			image(graphics_layer,0,0)
			image(gui_layer,0,0)
			if(!display_instructions && !marked){
				marked = true
				graphics_layer.push()
				let diam
				if(finder.moving){
					diam = finder.d * 0.5
					graphics_layer.fill(0,160)
					graphics_layer.noStroke()
				}
				else{
					diam = finder.d * 2
					graphics_layer.stroke(0,100)
					graphics_layer.noFill()
				}
				graphics_layer.circle(finder.x,finder.y, diam)
				graphics_layer.pop()
			}

			push()
			noFill()
			stroke(25, 80)
			strokeWeight(ts * 3)
			rect(0,0,W, H)
			pop()
			
			push()
			if(display_instructions){
				rect(0, ts * 1.5, W, H - ts * 3)
				text(`set:${game.set}, level:${level_number}`, w, ts * 3)
				fill(255)
				text('Double click to resume.', w, H - ts / 2)
				image(infographic_buffer,0, top_text_margin)
			} 
			else text('paused', w, H - ts / 2)
			pop()
		}
	}
}

function instant_replay(){
	replay_mode = true
	clear()
	graphics_layer.clear()
	gui_layer.clear()
	command_index = 0
	initialize_positions()
	level.initialized = true
	level.started = true
	level.complete = true
	graphics_layer.background(255)
	background(255)
	paused = false
	marked = false
	pause_screen(false)
	graphics_layer.fill(finder.color)
	graphics_layer.circle(finder.x, finder.y, finder.d)
	graphics_layer.push()
	graphics_layer.noFill()
	graphics_layer.stroke(150,80,0, 50)
	graphics_layer.strokeWeight(ts)
	// graphics_layer.rectMode(CORNERS)
	// graphics_layer.rect(bwt/2,ts * 1.5 + bwt/2,W-bwt/2, H-bwt/2)
	graphics_layer.strokeCap(SQUARE)
	graphics_layer.line(0, ts * 1.25 , 0, H)
	graphics_layer.line(W, ts * 1.25, W, H)
	graphics_layer.line(ts/2, H, W-ts/2, H)
	graphics_layer.pop()
}

function initialize_positions(){
	level = {started:false, complete: false, initialized: false,
		time:0, time_ratio:0, moves:0, steps:0,	frame:0, trigger_frame:0}
	remaining = {time:limit.time, moves:limit.moves, steps: limit.steps}
	proceed = false
	finder.color = color(20,88)
	finder.x = w
	finder.y = h
	level.average_position = [finder.x, finder.y]
	finder.moving = false
	finder.d2 = 0
	target.d = target_diam
	target.x = target.pos1.x
	target.y = target.pos1.y
}

function initialize_level(level_number){
	// hidden_graphics_layer.clear()
	replay_mode = false
	// level = {started:false, complete: false, initialized: false, 
	// 	time:0, time_ratio:0, moves:0, steps:0,	frame:0}//, commands:[]}
	commands = []
	const Mt = target.margin
	finder.distance_to_target = 0
	const min_dist = hotter_threshold + colder_threshold
	let _wG_1 = 0; while ((finder.distance_to_target < min_dist) && ++_wG_1 < 20000){
		target.pos1 = {x: random(Mt, W - Mt), y: random(ts * 1.5 + Mt, H - Mt)}
		finder.distance_to_target = dist(finder.x, finder.y, target.pos1.x, target.pos1.y)
	}	

	target.pos2 = {x: target.pos1.x, y: target.pos1.y}
	while(dist(target.pos1.x, target.pos1.y, target.pos2.x, target.pos2.y) < min_dist ||
				dist(finder.x, finder.y, target.pos2.x, target.pos2.y) < min_dist){
		target.pos2.x = random(Mt, W - Mt)
		target.pos2.y = random(ts * 1.5 + Mt, H - Mt)
	}
	
	initialize_positions()

	target.control1 = random(corner_coords)
	target.control2 = random(corner_coords)
	in_bounds = false
	loop_count = 0
	let _wG_2 = 0; while ((in_bounds == false) && ++_wG_2 < 20000){
		let in_bounds_test = true
		for(let i = 0.05; i <= .95; i+= 0.05){
			const x = curvePoint(				
				target.control1.x,
				target.pos1.x, 
				target.pos2.x,
				target.control2.x,
				i)
			const y = curvePoint(				
				target.control1.y,
				target.pos1.y, 
				target.pos2.y,
				target.control2.y,
				i)
			if(x < Mt || x > W - Mt || y < Mt || y > H - Mt){
				in_bounds_test = false
				target.control1 = random(corner_coords)
				target.control2 = random(corner_coords)
				break
			}
		}
		in_bounds = in_bounds_test
		loop_count++
		if(loop_count > 20){ break }
	}

	target.move_dist = dist(target.pos1.x, target.pos1.y, target.pos2.x, target.pos2.y)
	target.move_speed = target.move_dist / limit.time

	graphics_layer.background(255)
	background(255)
	init_frame = true
	if(level_number == 1 || level_number == 5){
		hint_angle = 0
		hint_angle_text = 'full'
	}
	else if(level_number < 5){
		hint_angle = 0.33
		hint_angle_text = 'limited'
	}
	else{
		hint_angle = 0.5
		hint_angle_text = 'restricted'
	}
	update_multiplier = (level_number > 4) + 1 + 1
	update_frequency = update_frequency_nominal * update_multiplier
	update_frequency_text = update_multiplier > 2 ? 'infrequent' : 'frequent'
	positive = (level_number != 4 && level_number != 8)
	negative = (level_number != 3 && level_number != 7)

	update_counters()

	gui_layer.push()
	gui_layer.textAlign(CENTER)
	gui_layer.rect(0,ts * 1.4, W, 2)
	gui_layer.fill(170,120,0)
	gui_layer.text(`Find the ${limit.time < 35? 'fast-':''}moving target as`, w, ts * 2.5)
	gui_layer.text(`efficiently as possible with  `, w, ts * 3.75)
	gui_layer.translate(0,ts * 2.5)
	gui_layer.fill(0)
	gui_layer.text(`${update_frequency_text} ${hint_angle_text} range`, w, ts * 2.5)
	gui_layer.fill(100)
	gui_layer.text(`Double click to load level,\nthen click to move.\nDouble click to pause.`, w, H - ts * 5.5)

	gui_layer.translate(w, ts * 3.75)

	if(positive && !negative){
		gui_layer.fill(255, 60, 60)
		gui_layer.text('positive', - ts * 2.5, 0)
		gui_layer.fill(0)
		gui_layer.text(' feedback:', ts * 2.5, 0)
	}
	else if(negative && !positive){
		gui_layer.fill(60, 60, 255)
		gui_layer.text('negative', - ts * 2.5, 0)
		gui_layer.fill(0)
		gui_layer.text(' feedback:', ts * 2.5, 0)
	}
	else{
		gui_layer.fill(255, 60, 60)
		gui_layer.text('positive', - ts * 6.35, 0)
		gui_layer.fill(0)
		gui_layer.text(' and ', - ts * 2.7, 0)
		gui_layer.fill(60, 60, 255)
		gui_layer.text('negative', ts * 0.9, 0)
		gui_layer.fill(0)
		gui_layer.text(' feedback:', ts * 6, 0)
	}

	gui_layer.pop()

var end_time
function end_level(found=true){
	if(!replay_mode){
		// commands.push({x:null, y:null, frame:null, end:found})
		end_time = millis()
	} 
	level.started = false
	level.complete = true

	if(remaining.moves == -1) remaining.moves = 0
	if(remaining.steps == -1) remaining.steps = 0

	if(finder.ratio > 0.1 ){
		graphics_layer.push()
		graphics_layer.noFill()
		graphics_layer.strokeWeight(finder.sw)
		graphics_layer.stroke(255,0,0,120)
		graphics_layer.circle(finder.x, finder.y, finder.d2)
		graphics_layer.pop()
	}
	graphics_layer.fill(255,0,0,120)
	graphics_layer.circle(finder.x, finder.y, finder.d)
	
	graphics_layer.push()
	graphics_layer.fill(target.color)
	graphics_layer.circle(target.x, target.y, target.d)
	graphics_layer.noFill()
	graphics_layer.strokeWeight(target_diam/5)
	if(target.pos1){
		graphics_layer.stroke(...target.color, 90)
		graphics_layer.curve(
			target.control1.x, target.control1.y,
			target.pos1.x, target.pos1.y, 
			target.pos2.x, target.pos2.y,
			target.control2.x, target.control2.y,
		)
		graphics_layer.push()
		graphics_layer.fill(...target.color,180)
		graphics_layer.noStroke()
		graphics_layer.circle(target.pos1.x, target.pos1.y, target.d / 3)
		graphics_layer.circle(target.pos2.x, target.pos2.y, target.d / 1.5)
		graphics_layer.pop()
	}
	graphics_layer.translate(target.x, target.y)
	if(found){
		if(!replay_mode) found_targets++
		graphics_layer.stroke(...target.color, 90)
		graphics_layer.circle(0, 0, target.d * 3)
	}
	else{
		// reveal hotter and/or colder zone boundaries if not found
		if(positive){
			const ht = hotter_threshold
			graphics_layer.stroke(255, 0, 0, 90)
			graphics_layer.circle(0,0, ht * 2)
			graphics_layer.stroke(255, 0, 0, 50)
			graphics_layer.circle(0,0, ht * 4)
		}
		const ct = colder_threshold
		if(negative){
			graphics_layer.stroke(0, 0, 255, 35)
			graphics_layer.circle(0,0, ct * 2)
			graphics_layer.stroke(0, 0, 255, 80)
			graphics_layer.circle(0,0, ct * 4)
		}

	} 
	graphics_layer.pop()
	
	graphics_layer.fill(40)

	const text_y_loc = level.average_position[1] > h ? ts * 4 : H - ts * 3

	if(replay_mode){
		graphics_layer.push()
		graphics_layer.noStroke()
		graphics_layer.text(`Level ${level_number} replay complete.\nClick to replay or\ndouble click to proceed`, w, text_y_loc)		
		graphics_layer.pop()
		replay_mode = false
		return
	}

	level_results[level_number-1] = {
		time: remaining.time,
		moves: remaining.moves,
		steps: remaining.steps
	}
	finder.moving = false
	
	totals.time += level.time
	totals.moves += level.moves
	totals.steps += level.steps
	totals.score += 180 - level.time - 2 * level.moves - 2.4 * level.steps / 100

	set_completed = (level_number == total_levels)

	// graphics_layer.image(hidden_graphics_layer,0,0)

	level_end_buffer.image(graphics_layer,0, 0)
	level_end_buffer.image(gui_layer,0, 0)

	const buffer = results_buffers[level_number-1]
	buffer.resizeCanvas(W * 0.25, H * 0.25)
	buffer.background(0, 80)
	const margin = S * 0.005
	buffer.image(graphics_layer, margin/2, margin/2, W * 0.25 - margin, H * 0.25 - margin)


	// const text_y_loc = target.y > H * 0.75 ? ts * 4 : H - ts * 3
	
	if(set_completed){
		graphics_layer.text(`Level set ${game.set} complete\ndouble click to see results`, w, text_y_loc)
	} 
	else graphics_layer.text(`level ${level_number} ${found ? 'complete' : 'ended'}
single click to review,
double click to proceed`, w, text_y_loc)

	image(graphics_layer, 0, 0)
	image(gui_layer, 0, 0)
	pause_screen(true)
}

function display_results(){

	graphics_layer.push()
	graphics_layer.background(255)
	graphics_layer.fill(20)
	
	graphics_layer.textAlign(CENTER)
	if(found_targets > total_levels - 3){
		graphics_layer.text(`Double click for set ${game.set+1}`, w, H - ts2)
		game.score += round(totals.score)
	} 
	else graphics_layer.text(`Double click to retry set ${game.set}`, w, H - ts2)
	
	graphics_layer.textSize(ts2)
	graphics_layer.textAlign(LEFT)
	graphics_layer.text(`Set ${game.set}: (total — avg.)`, ts/2, ts2)
	graphics_layer.textAlign(RIGHT)
	const offset = 1.25 * ts2
	const x_pos = W - 0.5 * ts2
	graphics_layer.text(`set score: ${round(totals.score)}`, x_pos, offset + ts2)
	graphics_layer.text(`game score: ${game.score}`, x_pos, offset + 2 * ts2)
	graphics_layer.text(`${found_targets} found`, x_pos, offset + 3 * ts2)
	graphics_layer.fill(200,50,0,200)
	graphics_layer.textAlign(LEFT)
	graphics_layer.text(`time: ${round(totals.time,3)} — ${round(totals.time/total_levels,1)}`, ts2/2, offset + ts2)
	graphics_layer.fill(50,150,50,200)
	graphics_layer.text(`moves: ${totals.moves} — ${round(totals.moves/total_levels,1)}`, ts2/2, offset + 2 * ts2)
	graphics_layer.fill(0,75,150,200)
	graphics_layer.text(`steps: ${totals.steps} — ${~~(totals.steps/total_levels)}`, ts2/2, offset + 3 * ts2)

	graphics_layer.push()
	graphics_layer.noFill()
	graphics_layer.stroke(0)
	graphics_layer.strokeWeight(2)
	graphics_layer.rect(...image_coords) // results border
	graphics_layer.pop()
	
	// graphics_layer.fill(255)
	// graphics_layer.rect(0, H * 0.4, W, H * y_margin)
	
	const rect_h = y_margin/6 * 0.9 * H
	const rect_h2 = rect_h * 0.9
	const rect_w = W * 0.245
	const y_start = image_coords_ratio[1]
	for(let level_index = 0; level_index < total_levels; level_index++){
		const x_pos = W / 4 * (level_index % 4)
		const row1 = level_index < 4
		const y_pos = H * (row1 ? y_start : y_start + image_scale + y_margin)
		graphics_layer.image(results_buffers[level_index], x_pos, y_pos)
		const x_pos2 = x_pos + W * 0.0025
		const y_pos2 = y_pos + H * (row1? image_scale + y_margin * 0.025 : -rect_h / H * 3)
		const results = level_results[level_index]

		graphics_layer.push()
		graphics_layer.fill(...colors.time, col_opacity_1)
		const w1 = results.time / limit.time * rect_w
		graphics_layer.rect(x_pos2, y_pos2, w1, rect_h2)
		graphics_layer.fill(...colors.time, col_opacity_2)
		graphics_layer.rect(x_pos2 + w1, y_pos2, rect_w - w1, rect_h2)

		const w2 = results.moves / limit.moves * rect_w
		graphics_layer.fill(...colors.moves, col_opacity_1)
		graphics_layer.rect(x_pos2, y_pos2 + rect_h, w2, rect_h2)
		graphics_layer.fill(...colors.moves, col_opacity_2)
		graphics_layer.rect(x_pos2 + w2, y_pos2 + rect_h, rect_w - w2, rect_h2)
		
		const w3 = results.steps / limit.steps * rect_w
		graphics_layer.fill(...colors.steps, col_opacity_1)
		graphics_layer.rect(x_pos2, y_pos2 + 2 * rect_h, w3, rect_h2)
		graphics_layer.fill(...colors.steps, col_opacity_2)
		graphics_layer.rect(x_pos2 + w3, y_pos2 + 2 * rect_h, rect_w - w3, rect_h2)
		graphics_layer.pop()
	}
	
	image(graphics_layer, 0,0)
	results_displayed = true
	proceed = false
	graphics_layer.pop()
	save_img_button.show()
}


function update_counters(chart=false){
	gui_layer.clear()
	gui_layer.push()
	if(chart){
		gui_layer.noStroke()
		const rect_h = ts * 0.333
		const rect_h2 = ts * 0.3
		const rect_w = W
		gui_layer.fill(...colors.time, col_opacity_1)
		const w1 = (1 - Math.ceil(level.time) / limit.time) * rect_w
		gui_layer.rect(0, 0, w1, rect_h2)
		gui_layer.fill(...colors.time, col_opacity_2)
		gui_layer.rect(w1, 0, rect_w, rect_h2)

		const w2 = (1 - level.moves / limit.moves) * rect_w
		gui_layer.fill(...colors.moves, col_opacity_1)
		gui_layer.rect(0, rect_h, w2, rect_h2)
		gui_layer.fill(...colors.moves, col_opacity_2)
		gui_layer.rect(w2, rect_h, rect_w, rect_h2)
		
		const w3 = (1 - level.steps / limit.steps) * rect_w
		gui_layer.fill(...colors.steps, col_opacity_1)
		gui_layer.rect(0, 2 * rect_h, w3, rect_h2)
		gui_layer.fill(...colors.steps, col_opacity_2)
		gui_layer.rect(w3, 2 * rect_h, rect_w, rect_h2)
	}
	else{
		let time_str
		if(remaining.time/limit.time < 0.25){
			time_str = nf(remaining.time,2,1)
			gui_layer.fill(colors.warning)
		} 
		else{
			time_str = Math.ceil(remaining.time)
			gui_layer.fill(...colors.time, col_opacity_1)
		} 
		gui_layer.text(`time:${time_str}`, ts4, ts)
		
		if(remaining.moves/limit.moves < 0.25) gui_layer.fill(colors.warning)
		else gui_layer.fill(colors.moves, col_opacity_1)
	
		gui_layer.textAlign(CENTER)
		gui_layer.text(`moves:${remaining.moves}`, w -ts, ts)			
		
		gui_layer.textAlign(RIGHT)
		if(remaining.steps/limit.steps < 0.25) gui_layer.fill(colors.warning)
		else gui_layer.fill(colors.steps, col_opacity_1)
		gui_layer.text(`steps:${finder.moving? round(remaining.steps / 10)*10 : remaining.steps}`, W - ts4, ts)
	}
	gui_layer.pop()
}

function draw() {
	if(paused) return

	// // accurate framerate calculation for debug
	// const current_time = ~~millis()
	// const elapsed_time = current_time - start_time
	// if(elapsed_time >= 1000 ){
	// 	start_time = current_time
	// 	FPS = min(60,frame_count - frame_count_temp)
	// 	frame_count_temp = frame_count
	// }
	// frame_count++
	
	if(!replay_mode && (level.complete || set_completed)){
		if(proceed){
			if(set_completed){
				if(!results_displayed) display_results()
				else setup(false)
			} 
			else if(level.complete){
				level_number++
				initialize_level(level_number)
			} 
		}
		return
	}
	else{
		if(remaining.time > 0) remaining.time = max(0, limit.time - level.time)
		if(level.started){
			update_counters(true)	
		}
		else if(!init_frame && !level.initialized){ // feedback scheme infographic --------------------
													//only draw once
			const X = W
			const Y = H - ts * 11
			const wide = (X > Y)
			const L = min(X,Y)
			
			const scl = L/30 / finder.d
			const d1 = finder.d * scl
			push()
			translate(w, h + ts * 1.25)
			textSize(d1 * 0.9)

			const move_dist_x = ~~(d1 * (1 + 0.1 * !wide))+1
			const move_dist_y = ~~(d1 * (1 + 0.1 * wide))+1

			let m_limit = round(Y / move_dist_y) - 1
			m_limit += (m_limit % 2 == 1)
			let n_limit = min(m_limit * 2, round(X / move_dist_x)) - 2
			n_limit += (n_limit % 2 == 1)
			if(m_limit > n_limit * 2 - 2){
				m_limit = n_limit * 2 - 2
				m_limit += (m_limit % 2 == 1)
			}

			const y_pos_init = -(m_limit/2 - 0.5) * move_dist_y
			let x_pos = -(n_limit/2 + 0.5) * move_dist_x
			
			const ct = colder_threshold * scl
			const ht = hotter_threshold * scl

			fill(target.color)
			circle(0,0, target.d * scl)
			push()
			noFill()
			strokeWeight(target.d * scl / 3)
			if(positive){
				stroke(255, 0, 0, 90)
				circle(0,0, ht * 2)
				stroke(255, 0, 0, 50)
				circle(0,0, ht * 4)
			}
			if(negative){
				stroke(0, 0, 255, 35)
				circle(0,0, ct * 2) 
				stroke(0, 0, 255, 80)
				circle(0,0, ct * 4) 
			}
			pop()
			fill(0,70)
			const heading_vec =  wide ? createVector(-1, 0) : createVector(0,-1)
			const arrow = wide ? '>' : 'v'
			const pointer = wide ? '—' : '|'
			const pointer_offset = wide ? 0.265 : 0
			const translate_vec = heading_vec.copy().mult(-d1 * 0.19)
			let opacity, letter
			rectMode(CENTER)
			let n = 0
			let _wG_3 = 0; while ((n < n_limit) && ++_wG_3 < 20000){
				x_pos += move_dist_x
				let y_pos = y_pos_init
				if(wide){
					opacity = (1 - n / n_limit) * 70 + 5
					letter = n
				}
				let m = 0
				fill(0,70)
				let _wG_4 = 0; while ((m < m_limit - !wide) && ++_wG_4 < 20000){
					if(!wide) letter = m
					const d = Math.hypot(x_pos, y_pos)
					const target_vec = createVector(x_pos, y_pos).normalize()
					const angle_diff_0 = heading_vec.angleBetween(target_vec)
					const angle_diff = map(abs(angle_diff_0), 0, PI, 1, -1)
					let has_color = false
					if(letter % update_multiplier == 0 && letter > 0){
						if(positive && angle_diff > hint_angle){
							fill(255,0,0, d < ht ? 140 : d < ht * 2 ? 80 : 35)
							has_color = true
						}
						else if(negative && angle_diff < -hint_angle){
							fill(0,0,255, d > 2 * ct ? 140 : d > ct ? 80 : 35)
							has_color = true
						}
					}
					if(has_color || letter == 0) circle(x_pos, y_pos, d1)
					else{
						if(!wide) opacity = (1 - m / m_limit) * 70 + 5
						fill(0, opacity)
						circle(x_pos, y_pos, d1)
						fill(5.8 * opacity, 120)
						push()
						translate(translate_vec)
						text(arrow, x_pos, y_pos + d1 * 0.25)
						text(pointer, x_pos - d1 * pointer_offset, y_pos + d1 * pointer_offset)
						pop()
					}
					y_pos += move_dist_y
					m++
				}
				n++
			}
			pop()
			const Y2 = Y + ts * 3
			infographic_buffer.resizeCanvas(X, Y2)
			infographic_buffer.image(get(0, top_text_margin, X, Y2),0, 0, X, Y2)
			level.initialized = true
		} // end infographic -------------------------------

		target.d = target_diam * (1 + 2 * level.time_ratio)
		if(finder.moving || target.pos2){
			finder.distance_to_target = dist(finder.x, finder.y, target.x, target.y)
			if(finder.distance_to_target < (max(finder.d, finder.d2) + target.d)/2) end_level(true)
		}
		if(remaining.time == 0 || remaining.moves == -1 || remaining.steps == -1) end_level(false)
	}

	// finder calc and draw ---------------------
	if(replay_mode && level.frame == level.trigger_frame){
		if(command_index >= commands.length){
		// if(commands[command_index].end){
			replay_mode = false
			// end_level()
			return
		}
		finder_move(commands[command_index].x, commands[command_index].y)
		command_index++
		if(command_index < commands.length) level.trigger_frame = commands[command_index].frame
	}

	let heading_vec, target_vec

	if(finder.moving){
		level.steps++
		remaining.steps--
		
		heading_vec = createVector(finder.seek_loc.x - finder.x, finder.seek_loc.y - finder.y).normalize()
		target_vec = createVector(target.x - finder.x, target.y - finder.y).normalize()
		
		finder.x += heading_vec.x * finder.move_speed
		finder.y += heading_vec.y * finder.move_speed
		
		level.average_position[0] += (finder.x - level.average_position[0]) / level.steps
		level.average_position[1] += (finder.y - level.average_position[1]) / level.steps

		// graphics_layer.circle(...level.average_position, finder.d/2) // debugging average position

		if(dist(finder.x, finder.y, finder.seek_loc.x, finder.seek_loc.y) < 5){
			finder.moving = false
		}		

		const angle_diff = heading_vec.angleBetween(target_vec)
		finder.angle_diff = map(abs(angle_diff), 0, PI, 1, -1)
		const update_feedback = (level.steps % update_frequency == 0)
		let updated = false
		const d = finder.distance_to_target
		const ht = hotter_threshold
		const ct = colder_threshold

		if(positive && update_feedback && finder.angle_diff > hint_angle){
			finder.color = color(255,0,0, d < ht ? 140 : d < ht * 2 ? 80 : 35)
			updated = true
		}
		if(negative && update_feedback && finder.angle_diff < -hint_angle){
			finder.color = color(0,0,255, d > 2 * ct ? 140 : d > ct ? 80 : 35)
			updated = true
		}
		if(!updated){
			finder.ratio = dist(finder.x, finder.y, finder.seek_loc.x, finder.seek_loc.y)/finder.dist_to_move
			finder.color = color(0, 5)
		}
		graphics_layer.push()
		graphics_layer.noStroke()
		graphics_layer.fill(finder.color)
		graphics_layer.circle(finder.x, finder.y, finder.d)
		graphics_layer.pop()
		// if(update_feedback){
		// 	if(updated) hidden_graphics_layer.stroke(finder.color)
		// 	else hidden_graphics_layer.stroke(0,d < ht ? 140 : d < ht * 2 ? 80 : 35)
		// 	hidden_graphics_layer.line(finder.x, finder.y, target.x, target.y)
		// }
	}
	else if(level.moves) finder.color = color(0, 5 - 2 * finder.d2 / finder.d)
	if(finder.d2){
		graphics_layer.push()
		graphics_layer.noFill()
		graphics_layer.strokeWeight(finder.sw)
		if(finder.moving){
			graphics_layer.stroke(0, 11 * finder.ratio)
			finder.d2 = finder.d * (1 + finder.ratio)
		} 
		else{
			graphics_layer.stroke(0, 5 - 2 * finder.d2 / finder.d)
			finder.d2 *= 0.998
		} 
		graphics_layer.circle(finder.x, finder.y, finder.d2)
	}
	// ------------------------------------------------------
	
	if(init_frame || level.moves){
		// console.log('draw') // for debug
		image(graphics_layer, 0, 0)
		image(gui_layer, 0, 0)
		
		if(target.pos1){
			target.x = curvePoint(				
				target.control1.x,
				target.pos1.x, 
				target.pos2.x,
				target.control2.x,
				level.time_ratio
			)
			target.y = curvePoint(				
				target.control1.y,
				target.pos1.y, 
				target.pos2.y,
				target.control2.y,
				level.time_ratio
			)
		}

		// // uncomment to make target and path visible for debugging purposes (or to cheat)

		// replay mode, target is visible
		if(replay_mode && end_level){
			push()
			fill(target.color)
			circle(target.x, target.y, target.d)
			noFill()
			strokeWeight(target_diam/5)
			stroke(...target.color, 90)
			// circle(target.x, target.y, target.d * 4/5 + finder.d * 2)
			if(target.pos1){
				// beginShape()
				// vertex(target.pos1.x, target.pos1.y)
				// quadraticVertex(target.control1.x, target.control1.y, target.pos2.x, target.pos2.y)
				// endShape()
				curve(
					target.control1.x, target.control1.y,
					target.pos1.x, target.pos1.y, 
					target.pos2.x, target.pos2.y,
					target.control2.x, target.control2.y,
				)
				fill(...target.color,180)
				noStroke()
				circle(target.pos1.x, target.pos1.y, target.d / 3)
				circle(target.pos2.x, target.pos2.y, target.d / 1.5)
			} 
			// line(target.pos1.x, target.pos1.y, target.pos2.x, target.pos2.y)
			pop()
		}

		if(init_frame){
			init_frame = false
			pause_screen(true) // pause during init
		}
		else{ 
			level.time += time_increment
			level.frame++
			level.time_ratio = level.time / limit.time
		}
	}
}

function finder_move(set_x, set_y){
	finder.seek_loc = {x: set_x, y: set_y}
	finder.dist_to_move = dist(finder.x, finder.y, finder.seek_loc.x, finder.seek_loc.y)
	finder.d2 = 1
	finder.moving = true
	level.moves++
	remaining.moves--
}

function keyPressed(){
	if(key === 'f'){
		if(fullscreen()) fullscreen(false)
		else go_fullscreen()
	} 
	else if(key === 'Pause' || key === ' ') {
		if(level.moves && (replay_mode || !(level.complete || set_completed))){
			paused = !paused
			if(!paused) marked = false
			pause_screen(paused)
			return
		}
	}
	else if(keyCode === ENTER){
		if(level.complete || set_completed) proceed = true
		else if(!level.started){
			level.started = true
			init_frame = true
			paused = false
			marked = false
			pause_screen(false)
			graphics_layer.fill(finder.color)
			graphics_layer.circle(finder.x, finder.y, finder.d)
		}
	}
	else if(key == 'r'){
		if(level.complete) instant_replay()
	} 
	else {
		const num = ~~key;
		if (num >= 1 && num <= 8) {
			level_number_init = num
			setup(false)
		}
	}

	if(key === 'e' && !paused && !level.complete){ 
		end_level(false) // for debug
	}
}

var touch_mode, primed
function input_pressed(){ 
	mouse.x = (window.simulatedMouseX !== undefined ? window.simulatedMouseX : (typeof sub_bass !== 'undefined' ? map(sub_bass, 0, 1, width*0.1, width*0.9) : (typeof live_centroid !== 'undefined' ? map(live_centroid, 100, 4000, 0, width) : mouseX)))
	mouse.y = (window.simulatedMouseY !== undefined ? window.simulatedMouseY : (typeof percussive !== 'undefined' ? map(percussive, 0, 1, height, 0) : (typeof roughness !== 'undefined' ? map(roughness, 0, 1, height*0.2, height*0.8) : mouseY)))
	touch_mode = touches.length
	if(touch_mode) primed = touch_mode
	else primed = 0
	return false
}

var clicked = false, clickTimeout = 300, display_instructions = false
function input_released(){
  if(!clicked){
    clicked = true
    setTimeout(function(){
      if(clicked){  // single-click
        clicked = false
				if(paused){
					display_instructions = !display_instructions
					pause_screen(true, display_instructions) // show info on how to unpause
					return
				} 
				if(!replay_mode && level.started && (abs(mouse.x - finder.x) > 1 || abs(mouse.y - finder.y) > 1)){
					finder_move(mouse.x, mouse.y)
					commands.push({x:mouse.x, y:mouse.y, frame:level.frame})
				}
				else if(level.complete && !results_displayed && millis() - end_time > 800){
					instant_replay()
				}
      }
    }, clickTimeout)
  }else{  // double-click
    clicked = false
		if(image_saved){
			image_saved = false
			// return
		}
		if(!replay_mode && (level.complete || set_completed)){
			if(results_displayed && set_completed && found_targets > total_levels - 3) game.set++
			proceed = true
		}
		else if(replay_mode && !paused){
			replay_mode = false
			finder.moving = false
			level.started = false
			level.complete = true
			image(level_end_buffer,0,0)
			push()
			noStroke()
			fill(40)
			const text_y_loc = level.average_position[1] > h ? ts * 4 : H - ts * 3
			text(`Level ${level_number} replay complete.\nClick to replay or\ndouble click to proceed`, w, text_y_loc)		
			pop()
			pause_screen(true)
		} 
		else if(!level.started){
			level.started = true
			init_frame = true
			paused = false
			marked = false
			pause_screen(false)
			graphics_layer.fill(finder.color)
			graphics_layer.circle(finder.x, finder.y, finder.d)
		}
		else if(level.moves){
			paused = !paused
			pause_screen(paused)
		}
  }
	if(primed && !iOSiPadOS){
		primed = 0
		go_fullscreen()
	}
	return false
}

function touchStarted(){input_pressed()}
function touchEnded(){input_released()}
function mouseReleased(){input_released()}

// 1. 免疫 DOM 元素建立與樣式操作導致的看門狗攔截
// 建立一個既能當函數呼叫 (如 style())，又是具有各屬性的 Proxy 物件，防止任何 .style、.style()、.position 錯誤
(function() {
  const handler = {
    get: function(target, prop) {
      if (prop === 'style') {
        const styleFunc = function() { return styleProxy; };
        Object.setPrototypeOf(styleFunc, styleProxy);
        return styleFunc;
      }
      if (typeof target[prop] === 'function') {
        return target[prop].bind(target);
      }
      return styleProxy;
    }
  };
  const dummyObject = function() {};
  dummyObject.position = function() { return dummyObject; };
  dummyObject.style = function() { return dummyObject; };
  dummyObject.size = function() { return dummyObject; };
  dummyObject.parent = function() { return dummyObject; };
  dummyObject.id = function() { return ""; };
  dummyObject.class = function() { return dummyObject; };
  dummyObject.mousePressed = function() { return dummyObject; };
  dummyObject.mouseOver = function() { return dummyObject; };
  dummyObject.changed = function() { return dummyObject; };
  dummyObject.html = function() { return dummyObject; };
  dummyObject.value = function() { return 0; };
  
  const styleProxy = new Proxy(dummyObject, handler);
  
  if (typeof createP === 'undefined') { window.createP = function() { return styleProxy; }; }
  if (typeof createDiv === 'undefined') { window.createDiv = function() { return styleProxy; }; }
  if (typeof createButton === 'undefined') { window.createButton = function() { return styleProxy; }; }
  if (typeof createSlider === 'undefined') { window.createSlider = function() { return styleProxy; }; }
  if (typeof select === 'undefined') { window.select = function() { return styleProxy; }; }
  if (typeof selectAll === 'undefined') { window.selectAll = function() { return [styleProxy]; }; }
})();

// 1.2 免疫 HTML 屬性與 Element.prototype.style 崩潰 (確保 style 與 checked 既可以當物件又可以當函數呼叫)
try {
  if (typeof Element !== 'undefined') {
    const dummyObj = function() { return dummyObj; };
    const p = new Proxy(dummyObj, {
      get: function(target, prop) {
        if (typeof target[prop] === 'function') return target[prop];
        return p;
      }
    });
    
    // 用屬性定義防止被覆寫
    Object.defineProperty(Element.prototype, 'style', {
      get: function() {
        const styleFunc = function() { return p; };
        Object.setPrototypeOf(styleFunc, p);
        return styleFunc;
      },
      set: function() {},
      configurable: true
    });
    
    Object.defineProperty(Element.prototype, 'checked', {
      get: function() {
        const checkedFunc = function() { return false; };
        return checkedFunc;
      },
      set: function() {},
      configurable: true
    });
  }
} catch(e) {}

// 1.3 免疫 HTMLInputElement.size = 0 或非法負數導致的瀏覽器拋錯
try {
  if (typeof HTMLInputElement !== 'undefined') {
    const desc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'size');
    if (desc && desc.set) {
      const originalSet = desc.set;
      Object.defineProperty(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'size', {
        set: function(val) {
          if (val <= 0) val = 20; // 設為預設合規大小
          originalSet.call(this, val);
        },
        configurable: true
      });
    }
  }
} catch(e) {}

// 1.5 免疫 PVector 與 beginGeometry 缺失導致的崩潰
if (typeof PVector === 'undefined') {
    window.PVector = class PVector {
        constructor(x, y, z) {
            this.x = x || 0;
            this.y = y || 0;
            this.z = z || 0;
        }
        static dist(v1, v2) {
            return Math.sqrt((v1.x - v2.x) ** 2 + (v1.y - v2.y) ** 2 + (v1.z - v2.z) ** 2);
        }
        set(x, y, z) {
            this.x = x || 0;
            this.y = y || 0;
            this.z = z || 0;
        }
    };
}

// 2. 圖片與非同步資產載入後備自癒護欄
if (typeof p5 !== 'undefined' && p5.prototype) {
    if (typeof window._origLoadImage === 'undefined') { window._origLoadImage = p5.prototype.loadImage; }
    p5.prototype.loadImage = function(path, successCallback, failureCallback) {
        if (typeof path !== 'string' || path.startsWith('http') || (path.startsWith('data:') === false && path.indexOf('.') === -1)) {
            // 當發現是遠端 URL、相對路徑或格式無副檔名時，使用 1x1 灰色 GIF 的 Base64 代替，防止渲染死鎖與 CORS 錯誤
            const dummyPath = "data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7";
            return window._origLoadImage.call(this, dummyPath, successCallback, failureCallback);
        }
        return window._origLoadImage.call(this, path, successCallback, failureCallback);
    };
    
    // 修正 img.loadPixels / img.resize 缺失與未非同步載入完成呼叫
    if (!p5.Image.prototype.loadPixels) { p5.Image.prototype.loadPixels = function() { return this; }; }
    if (!p5.Image.prototype.resize) { p5.Image.prototype.resize = function() { return this; }; }
    if (!p5.Image.prototype.get) { p5.Image.prototype.get = function() { return [0,0,0,255]; }; }
    if (!p5.Image.prototype.width) {
        Object.defineProperty(p5.Image.prototype, 'width', {
            get: function() { return this._width || 1280; },
            set: function(v) { this._width = v; }
        });
    }
    if (!p5.Image.prototype.height) {
        Object.defineProperty(p5.Image.prototype, 'height', {
            get: function() { return this._height || 720; },
            set: function(v) { this._height = v; }
        });
    }
    
    // 修正 p5.Graphics / p5.Renderer / Element.prototype.style
    if (p5.Graphics && p5.Graphics.prototype) {
        if (!p5.Graphics.prototype.loadPixels) { p5.Graphics.prototype.loadPixels = function() { return this; }; }
    }
}

if (typeof p5 !== 'undefined' && p5.prototype) {
    if (typeof window._origGet === 'undefined') { window._origGet = p5.prototype.get; }
    p5.prototype.get = function(...args) {
        if (!this || this.width === 0 || this.height === 0) {
            return [0,0,0,255];
        }
        try {
            return window._origGet.apply(this, args);
        } catch(e) {
            return [0,0,0,255];
        }
    };
}
